'''Pruning shears''' were gardening tools equipped on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[R0/5T.N1 tree feeder]]. The pruning shears were located at the end of a moveable arm that could be deployed from the droid's torso.<ref name="EGTD" />
